title: Recidiviz Identity Ingest Pipeline Tenant Config
description: Per-person-type configuration for a tenant's identity ingest pipeline, parsed by identity_ingest_pipeline_config.py. Each top-level key is a PersonType value, lowercased. Attributes and id types absent from a block fall back to the code defaults defined in identity_ingest_pipeline_config.py.

max_ids_per_type_overrides.description: Per-id-type overrides of the maximum number of external IDs of a given type a person can have before that ID value is assumed to be a sentinel with no real ID meaning (e.g. InmateNum='000000'). ID types not listed here fall back to the pipeline default.

conflict_check_overrides.description: Per-attribute overrides of whether a divergence (fragments in one cluster recording different values for the attribute) is a conflict that rejects the cluster. Only the exact-match enums sex, gender, and ethnicity are configurable. The name components, name suffix, and birthdate are always checked.

resolution_strategy_overrides.description: Per-attribute overrides of how a kept cluster stores an attribute whose fragments diverge benignly (not enough to conflict).

resolution_strategy.description: keep_latest stores the value from the fragment with the latest upper-bound date; set_null stores nothing.
